en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a modernist building with a pronounced geometric roof and stone facade. There are large windows with awnings and a series of steps leading up to the entrance, flanked by potted plants and a sculpted reclining lion. A woman in mid-century clothing is descending the steps. A sign near the entrance reads 'OLYMPIA', suggesting the name of the building, possibly a hotel or restaurant.
